selection_basis: fixed model slugs rather than the historical dynamic openrouter/free router
same-generation primary and breadth models to reduce architecture confounding
cost-effective primary suitable for repeated reliability trials
stronger breadth model predeclared before outcome inspection

routing.reason: prevent one experimental condition from silently reaching a different upstream provider

mitigation: freeze model slug and public release date
pin upstream provider and disable provider fallbacks
record OpenRouter/OpenAI response model identity and system_fingerprint on every live call when available
flag any model identity or fingerprint drift before aggregation

historical_migration_model.reason: dynamic routing makes the underlying model identity non-controlled

supervisor_confirmation_scope: whether the provisional Luna primary and Sol breadth models should remain the study models
